Subject: Redwood DPA / Order Form redlines — SCCs & transfer impact

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CareCo's procurement and legal team have reviewed the MSA + order form and attached a consolidated redline (CareCo_Redlines_v2.docx). The main open items from our side are:

- SCCs: we need the SCC Annex filled out with the processor roles and subprocessors; attached is our template (SCCs-Annex-CareCo.pdf).
- Transfer impact: for EU-hosted patient data, procurement is asking for a transfer impact addendum that clarifies routing (EU-first) and fallback to US-only hosting if EU capacity is exhausted.
- Audit & KMS: they want explicit audit windows and confirmation that Redwood will support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for the Private deployment.
- Liability and order-form pricing: finance flagged a cross-reference to the order form (pricing exhibits) — if we increase data localization costs there, they will want us to show the delta.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the SCCs annex and who can run through a technical dataflow diagram with our security lead? We attached a simple diagram (DataFlowDiagram_CareCo.png).

Best,
Lena
Legal & Procurement — CareCo Health GmbH

Forwarding CareCo's consolidated redlines — high priority. Key asks summarized below. Please:

1) Legal (Ben): take the SCCs-Annex and draft our processor-role table with explicit subprocessor footnotes; confirm whether our standard SCCs fill will require a DPA addendum or a transfer addendum.
2) Product/Security (Karthik): review the DataFlowDiagram_CareCo.png and confirm feasibility for EU-first routing + fallback path. If EU capacity could cause automatic fallback to US, we need language for deterministic routing + customer opt-in on fallback.
3) Sales/RevOps (Marissa): get pricing delta for EU-localized dedicated capacity per month so we can present a clear number.

I'll own the client comms. Lena: we'll come back with a prioritized list and a proposed timeline by EOD Tuesday.

Naomi
Director, Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Naomi — thanks for the ping. Notes from legal review after quick pass on the attachments:

- SCCs annex: we can populate the processor/processor-subprocessor table; however CareCo's template includes a liability carveout tied to data residency incidents. We should avoid changing our global liability clauses; propose: call out a narrow remedy (temporary credits + migration support) rather than raising cap.

- Transfer addendum: recommend a short customer-facing addendum that states: (1) default routing is EU regions for EU customer data; (2) Redwood may failover to compatible regions (including US) only when EU capacity is unavailable and only after explicit customer notification and opt-in for automated failover; (3) for Private deployments we can support customer-managed keys — add KMS exhibit.

- Audit windows & access: CareCo requests annual on-site audit language. We should provide audit evidence (SOC 2 + technical logs) and offer on-site or remote audit by exception with expense reimbursement.

Action items I can take this week: populate SCCs-Annex-CareCo.pdf with our entries, draft the transfer addendum language (two paragraphs + a short SLA on notification), and prepare a KMS exhibit. Karthik — I will need a 30-min call with you tomorrow to confirm the technical feasibility of the notification + opt-in gating. Marissa — can you slot EU-localized pricing options so we can show the delta?

Ben
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi and Ben — that approach sounds good. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- The customer notification before failover should be machine‑readable (we use the notification to run our internal compliance gating). If you include an event schema (sample webhook payload) in the transfer addendum that would be ideal.
- For audit evidence, CareCo is prepared to accept SOC 2 + aggregated logs quarterly; on-site audits will be a rare exception.
- For KMS: confirm whether HSM-backed keys are available in the Private deployment, and whether key rotation policies can be aligned with our internal policy (90 days).

If you can share the populated SCCs annex and the transfer addendum draft by EOD Wednesday CET, Procurement will consolidate and revert with one negotiation pass. We can follow with a tech call afterwards.

Best,
Lena
